judge.reader: an engineer joining the team next year who wants to know why claim status is cached and whether they can change it
questions: Does the title state the decision, and does the record commit to it plainly?
Does it give the two rejected options with the reasons the notes give, and no options the notes don't mention?
Does it state the costs (up to 10 minutes stale, no invalidation, errors on a miss during an outage) as well as the benefits?
Does it follow the format of the team's existing ADR, and leave the cache-warming question open rather than deciding it?
